purpose: Define the canonical automation causality chain from Event occurrence through Trigger evaluation to Runner/Routine dispatch, including explicit provenance and no-reentry boundaries.

topics.purpose: Define the canonical automation causality chain from Event occurrence through Trigger evaluation to Runner/Routine dispatch, including explicit provenance and no-reentry boundaries.

semantics.causality_rule: Every edge in the automation chain is explicit and traceable.
semantics.ordering_rule: Execution order comes from flow/target semantics, not Topic/containment/file ordering.
semantics.payload_rule: Event/Trigger context remains inert until consumed by the explicit target operation.
semantics.reentry_rule: Recursive automation paths use explicit inflight/no-reentry gates where applicable.
semantics.provenance_rule: Execution trace retains Event occurrence, Trigger, target and Runner/Routine refs.
semantics.failure_rule: Failure at any pre-dispatch step produces no hidden partial target execution.

invariants.rule: Automation semantics remain explicit across Event, Trigger, Runner and Routine identities, and execution order never derives from incidental structure or serialization order.

hard_gates.condition: automation execution inferred from structural adjacency
recursive path lacks required inflight gate
failed validation still partially dispatches target

references.purpose: Recursive automation uses explicit no-reentry gates.
